summary: A workflow is a file in the repository: when to run, and jobs with steps on fresh machines. The Python, gateway and page jobs run side by side, and the image job needs all three. CI uses a fake writer, a service container with a throwaway password and the least permission. The file was checked with a linter and every command by hand; it was never run on GitHub.
goal: M13: run tests on every push.

items.text: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml from the template and lint it
Run each command of each job by hand and write down any that fails
Push a branch, open a pull request and read the log of the slowest job
Misspell a name in needs and read the linter, then make a test fail on purpose and look at the red mark
Add the secret finder to the Python job and write one README sentence on what must be green before a merge
Commit the workflow and the README
Play the Workflow Check game to the end and see your score
